title: Invariant subspaces, conductors, and triangulability
objectives: Test invariance of a subspace and read the resulting block form
Relate the polynomials of a restriction to those of the operator
Compute conductors into invariant subspaces and prove their properties
Use the linear-conductor lemma and the flag form of triangularity
prerequisites: Bases, matrices of operators, eigenvalues, determinants, the minimal polynomial and the Cayley-Hamilton theorem (Chapters 4 to 14).
source_scope: Read: the stored caption texts at positions 30 and 31. The stored text at position 30 duplicates the transpose lecture at position 23, so the invariant-subspace topics of that recording were taken from YouTube's automatic English captions for the same video. The running example, extended proofs, laboratory and exercises are original.
